title: api-gateway: elevated latency and errors
description: SLO burn-rate alert: api-gateway p95 latency reached 408ms (normally ~186ms) and error rate peaked at 5.5%.
root_cause_detail: recommendation-service was overloaded by a batch job, saturating CPU and slowing responses; api-gateway calls timed out.
expected_symptoms: api-gateway downstream_latency_ms rises from ~116ms to ~950ms (client timeout 1000ms)
timeout and retry logs on calls from api-gateway to recommendation-service
api-gateway p95 latency rises to ~408ms, error rate up to ~5.5%
api-gateway CPU and memory stay near baseline
recommendation-service CPU near saturation (~78%) and server-side latency elevated
resolution: Paused the batch job, scaled recommendation-service and moved the job to off-peak hours.
